tytul: Apricot jam with apricot kernels: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for apricot jam with added apricot kernels (the almond-like seeds inside the stones). [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: Amygdalin is the main cyanogenic glycoside in apricot kernels, and it breaks down to cyanide. [T:SLO-070] EFSA estimates that a toddler would go over the acute reference dose for cyanide after more than 0.06 g of raw apricot kernels, and an adult after more than 0.37 g. [T:SLO-070]

akapity: JarAtlas has found no data on how much of this toxin is left in jam. [T:-]
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for apricot jam with kernels from a checked source. [T:-]
JarAtlas has a card for apricot jam without added pectin, made without kernels. [T:-]
